Each package line is formatted into a fixed 256-byte buffer, but config.c accepts package names up to CONFIG_MAX_TEXT (1024) bytes. A name of about 243 to 1024 bytes passes frontmatter validation under R2.8.5, then cwiki_tex_generate fails with EINVAL. The user gets no source-located report.

A block marked `% cwiki: norender` still gets an UNKNOWN_ENV report from check_env when it opens, and an UNTRUSTED report from finish_block, because the directive is only seen on a later line. R2.9.2a says a suppressed block is not compiled and is not an error.
No deterministic test covers the branch where a `% VimTeX: SynIgnore on` line ends an open block (finished as unterminated on line index - 1). Only fuzz inputs reach it.
